newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 30.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ruling Democratic Party (PDCI) candidate defeats opposition Rally of the Republicans in northern constituency in Korhogo, one of eight national assembly seats being contested in Sunday's by-elections; PDCI wins control of three out of four municipal councils on offer, opposition Ivorian Popular Front wins the fourth; polls pass off peacefully
- Number of tourists visiting Ivory Coast rose by 20,000 in 1996 to around 240,000
- Cocoa company SACO looks to diversify chocolaate products for sale to the sub-region
- Ivorian police seize 3.7 kg of heroin from Thailand in record haul; Nigerian woman charged

- Ivorian Popular Front leader Laurent Gbagbo on course for re-election in parliamentary by-election; heavy turnout in opposition stronghold of Gagnoa where polling in November 1995 parliamentary elections was postponed following violence
- Army team SOA defeat 1996 league champions Africa Sports 3-0 in Felix Houphouet-Boigny soccer challenge cup final
